task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an exciting round of TextWorld? You do! Here is how to play! First, it would be great if you could go to the west. Okay, and then, retrieve the fondue from the floor of the sauna. And if you do that, you're the winner!
description:
You've entered a cookhouse. You begin to take stock of what's in the room.



There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an unblocked exit to the west.

thought: I should go west as instructed to proceed towards the sauna.
feedback:

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

There is a fondue on the floor.
